subtasks.description: Declare the 16-bit CRC register and the 1-bit combinational intermediate wire 'inv' as specified in S002 and S004.
constraints: Ensure that the CRC register width and signal names match the interface defined in S002.

subtasks.description: Implement combinational assignment: assign inv = BITVAL ^ CRC[15];

Implement sequential always block with asynchronous reset (RST high sets CRC to 0) and on posedge CLK with Enable high, update CRC by left-shifting and applying XOR feedback at bits 12 and 5, and setting bit 0 to inv; other bits shift from CRC[i-1]. Enforce enable gating.
constraints: Use explicit bit assignments for the shift-and-XOR pattern; do not use generate loops.
